rows.claim: AZ loss, disk-controller failure, or a true network partition is survivable, or its AZ1 MinIO/ingress limitation is recorded as an accepted risk.
rows.notes: Not run. The 3-AZ AZ1 MinIO/ingress limitation is recorded in accepted_risks; that record is not a verified HA-23 row.

accepted_risks.risk: The 3-AZ reference has four MinIO nodes with two in AZ1 at EC:2, and the edge/VIP pair is AZ1-only.
accepted_risks.impact: Losing AZ1 leaves two MinIO drives and blocks writes, and removes public ingress until AZ1 returns; reads may continue.
accepted_risks.residual_risk: AZ1 loss is not survivable for ingress or MinIO writes; there is no second site.
accepted_risks.next_action: PLAT-009/follow-up topology review: a second ingress site and a MinIO placement/parity review.
